description: Exponentially weighted moving average update with weight 1/8 and 10 fractional bits (ewma_*_add of DECLARE_EWMA)
notes: Linux kernel v6.11, the ewma_##name##_add function generated by DECLARE_EWMA (include/linux/average.h), instantiated as in mac80211's DECLARE_EWMA(avg_signal, 10, 8) (net/mac80211/sta_info.h, line 126): precision 10, weight_rcp 8, so ilog2(8) = 3. The struct field becomes the parameter s (unsigned long as uint64_t) and the new internal value is returned instead of stored with WRITE_ONCE. Written by us from the macro. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: a branch on s == 0, a mul by 7, two shifts, an add and a phi: 11 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
